source.sourceText: Brush hair smooth
Opa stands in front of mirror holding a brush, but his hair is a twisted bird's nest with the brush embedded in it.
Each brush stroke creates a new knot, and the knots tighten the more you brush; hair eventually coils around the brush like a topiary.
Opa brushes once, hair stands up in a giant knot.

beats.strategy: Opa pulls the brush out slowly, hoping to unwind the knot.
beats.visibleConsequence: The knot tightens into a bun that pulls his head back.
beats.newInformation: Pulling the brush out causes the hair to cinch, not loosen.

source.sourceText: Opa pulls the brush out slowly, hoping to unwind the knot.
The knot tightens into a bun that pulls his head back.
Pulling the brush out causes the hair to cinch, not loosen.

beats.strategy: Opa uses a wide-tooth comb to gently work through the tangle.
beats.visibleConsequence: The comb adds more knots, and his hair expands into a giant sphere around his head.
beats.newInformation: Any grooming tool multiplies knots instead of removing them.

source.sourceText: Opa uses a wide-tooth comb to gently work through the tangle.
The comb adds more knots, and his hair expands into a giant sphere around his head.
Any grooming tool multiplies knots instead of removing them.

beats.strategy: Opa applies hair conditioner to make strands slippery.
beats.visibleConsequence: The hair becomes like rubber, and the brush bounces off, but the knots stretch and snap back with more loops.
beats.newInformation: Conditioner turns hair elastic, making tangles spring-loaded.

source.sourceText: Opa applies hair conditioner to make strands slippery.
The hair becomes like rubber, and the brush bounces off, but the knots stretch and snap back with more loops.
Conditioner turns hair elastic, making tangles spring-loaded.

beats.strategy: Opa puts on a hat to hide the hair and stop brushing.
beats.visibleConsequence: The hat is sucked into the hair-knot and swallowed, disappearing into the tangled mass.
beats.newInformation: The hair's tangling now acts like a living trap, consuming objects.

source.sourceText: Opa puts on a hat to hide the hair and stop brushing.

beats.strategy: Opa uses scissors to cut the hair away.
beats.visibleConsequence: The hair regrows instantly into a larger, tighter knot, trapping the scissors.
beats.newInformation: Cutting triggers accelerated regrowth with more tangles.

This does not prove actual repetitive choreography. SFE uses independent rule-linked state/information change checks.

blockers.unsupportedResponseMeaning: Explicit object response exists but existing response classifier cannot classify knot multiplication/tangling. No policy lookup can resolve an UNSUPPORTED_RESPONSE. Category C applies to classified responses with missing compatibility; raw-013 is B.

resultAfter.meaning: responseType classifies the impossible object response, not the existence of a rule

blockers.whyDifferentFromSFE: Presence, linkage and progression can be supported without a Naturalness response category or object compatibility policy.

noBugClaim: No independent scoring bug established. The ranking lexical evidence mismatch and synthetic beat representation are acquisition defects; unresolved response coverage is retained, not patched.
remainingLegitimateQualityDifference: SFE sufficiency and Naturalness requirement for a direct configured affordance relation are separate quality requirements; taxonomy limits prevent a fully supported Naturalness judgment here.
